name: Cask of Merlot
summary: In Stormwind, Cask of Merlot supplies Lakeshire while Blackrock orcs cut its trade routes.

sections.title: A Taste of the Capital
sections.body: Harvested and fermented in the heart of the kingdom, the merlot comes from the Galina Winery's cellars. The winery lies along the canals bordering Stormwind's Trade District, where winemaker Roberto Pupellyverbos tends its vintages for the capital's refined tastes. Unlike Duskwood moonshine or Elwynn spirits, this wine reflects the craft of human vintners working within the city's walls.

sections.title: Restocking Lakeshire
sections.body: When the Blackrock clan invaded the Redridge Mountains, supply routes failed and Lakeshire lost its usual merchant shipments. With locals parched and terrified, Barkeep Daniels sends willing couriers across the kingdom to refill his tavern's cellars. The cask gives defenders and refugees by Lake Everstill a gentle drink to wash down their rations.

faq.q: Where can I find a Cask of Merlot?
faq.answer: Roberto Pupellyverbos sells the Cask of Merlot inside the Galina Winery, along the canals at the edge of Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: Why does Barkeep Daniels need this wine?
faq.answer: The Blackrock orc invasion of Redridge has cut off Lakeshire's regular shipments, and Barkeep Daniels is nearly out of alcohol. He sends adventurers across southern Azeroth to secure regional specialties and keep his patrons satisfied.

faq.q: What other drinks are collected alongside the Merlot?
faq.answer: Daniels also asks for a skin of Sweet Rum from Goldshire, a bottle of Moonshine from Darkshire, and a keg of Thunderbrew Lager from Grimbooze Thunderbrew in the hills of Westfall.

faq.q: Is the Galina Winery in danger?
faq.answer: The Galina Winery is safe behind Stormwind City's stone ramparts. Bandits and orc raids trouble outlying lands such as Westfall and Redridge, while trade and winemaking continue in the capital's canal district.

angles.text: For the Alliance, fetching the cask shows the contrast between Stormwind's secure canal district and Redridge's embattled towns under siege.
